lines.en: label rinspecial55:
scene otoharinoutside1
: So...are you gonna start? Or should I?
lines.zh: : 那么……你要开始，还是我来？

lines.en: : You start. Talking about serious stuff is hard and awkward and I feel like I’ve been doing it with literally everyone lately.
lines.zh: : 你来。谈严肃的事情又难又尴尬，而且我觉得最近我简直跟每个人都谈过了。

lines.en: : Plus, I’ve apparently already got another talk lined up for later tonight and I feel like I’m going to be the one to have to get that one started.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我今晚晚些时候好像还排了另一场谈话，而且我觉得那一场也得由我来开头。

lines.en: : On the bright side...at least you’re getting pizza?
lines.zh: : 往好处想……至少有披萨？

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s pretty much the only thing keeping me hanging on at this point, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这大概是目前唯一支撑我撑下去的东西了，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside2
: Hah...
: Being in a relationship is a lot of fucking work, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 谈恋爱真他妈的累人，是吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. But that’s exactly why I-
lines.zh: : 是啊。但正因为如此我才——

lines.en: : Shut up. You literally just told me to start and I’ve barely even said anything yet.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。你刚刚才让我开头，我几乎还没说上几句呢。

lines.en: : My bad. The nerves are kicking in.
lines.zh: : 我的错。紧张劲儿上来了。

lines.en: : There shouldn’t be any nerves at this point, Rin.
lines.zh: : 事到如今没什么好紧张的了，Rin。

lines.en: : There will always be nerves. I’m a nervous person. Especially around people as pretty and talented as you.
lines.zh: : 我永远都会紧张。我就是个容易紧张的人。尤其是在像你这么漂亮又有才华的人面前。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside3
: Think buttering me up will make me go any easier on you?
lines.zh: : 觉得给我灌迷魂汤，我就会对你手软？

lines.en: : Think? No. Hope? Yes.
lines.zh: : 觉得？不是。希望？是的。

lines.en: : Well, it won't.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那不会。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside4
: Thankfully...I’m not mad. So there’s not really anything to “go easy” about.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地……我没有生气。所以其实也没什么好“手软”的。

lines.en: : I’m just...confused. Your parents breaking up is such a huge...important thing to hide from me. And I thought I made it plenty clear in the past that I don’t want you keeping those things to yourself.
lines.zh: : 我只是……困惑。你父母离婚是件这么重大的事，你居然瞒着我。而且我以为我以前已经说得很清楚了，我不希望你把这些事憋在心里。

lines.en: : You have. But you also made it clear that you want things to be easy and fun and-
lines.zh: : 你是说过。可你也说得很清楚，你希望一切都轻松又有趣——

lines.en: : Shut up. I’m still not done.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我还没说完。

lines.en: : Okay. But you might be better off just bringing a roll of duct tape with you whenever you leave the house from now on because I’m extremely bad at keeping quiet and might require some assistance.
lines.zh: : 好。不过你以后出门大概最好随身带一卷胶带，因为我实在太不会闭嘴了，可能需要借助外力。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside5
: I didn’t realize you were into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还好这一口。

lines.en: : I am into literally anything you want to do to me whenever you are ready to actually do things to me. Which might be never at this rate because I suck at this.
lines.zh: : 只要你真的打算对我做点什么，我什么都愿意让你对我做。照这个进度，那天大概永远都不会来，因为我太差劲了。

lines.en: : You wanna know what you really suck at? Understanding me.
lines.zh: : 你知道你真正差劲的是什么吗？是理解我。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside6
: Yeah...Yeah, that’s hard.
lines.zh: : 是啊……是啊，这很难。

lines.en: : It’s not just you, either. I’m kind of like that with everyone.
lines.zh: : 也不只是对你。我跟所有人都差不多是这样。

lines.en: : If I don’t see or hear something firsthand and just have to figure out whatever the issue is on my own, I’m basically screwed. Which is one of the big reasons I didn’t tell you about my parents.
lines.zh: : 如果不是亲眼看到、亲耳听到，而是得靠自己去琢磨问题出在哪儿，我基本就完蛋了。这也是我没告诉你我父母的事的一大原因。

lines.en: : Everything happened so quickly and I panicked because I’ve been making them out to be the paragon of all things lesbian and if {i}they{/i} couldn’t last-
lines.zh: : 一切发生得太快了，我慌了——因为我一直把他们当成同性恋的完美典范，如果连{i}他们{/i}都没能走到最后——

lines.en: : You didn’t think we would either.
lines.zh: : 你就觉得我们也走不到最后。

lines.en: : It’s more like I didn’t think {i}you{/i} would think we would last.
lines.zh: : 更像是，我觉得{i}你{/i}会觉得我们走不到最后。

lines.en: : I have no idea if we will or not. But it’s not like I’m in any rush to find out. I like taking things slow, remember?
lines.zh: : 我不知道我们能不能。但我也不急着知道答案。我喜欢慢慢来，记得吗？

lines.en: : It’s hard not to. And if that sounded insulting, it wasn’t supposed to be. We’re just really different people on the inside.
lines.zh: : 这很难不记得。如果那句话听起来像在损你，那不是我的本意。我们只是内心深处真的很不一样的人。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside7
: Kind of ironic how the hardest part of dating a girl so far has been also just, you know, {i}being{/i} a girl.
lines.zh: : 挺讽刺的——到目前为止，跟女生交往最难的部分，竟然就是……{i}当{/i}个女生。

lines.en: : As much as I want to tell you you’re looking at it all wrong and that has nothing to do with how, uhh...bumpy things have been so far, I can’t. You’re exactly right.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想告诉你，你全都看错了，这跟我们到目前为止的……呃……磕磕绊绊毫无关系，但我不能。你完全说对了。

lines.en: : That’s on me, though. I’ve got like, zero exposure to this sort of thing and all I really know is that I like you and don’t mind having your tongue in my mouth a few times a day.
lines.zh: : 不过那是我的问题。我对这种事基本毫无经验，我只知道我喜欢你，也不介意你一天把舌头伸进我嘴里几次。

lines.en: : But where you’re wrong is thinking whatever happens between your parents has anything to do with {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但你想错的地方在于，你父母之间发生的事跟{i}我们{/i}毫无关系。

lines.en: : It’s not like hearing about them splitting up is going to make me think, “Oh. I guess all lesbians are doomed now. How sad.”
lines.zh: : 听到他们分手，我也不至于就觉得“哦。看来所有同性恋都注定完蛋了。真遗憾。”

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside8
: See! Then this is just one more example of me not understanding something I’m supposed to understand because that’s exactly what I thought you’d think!
lines.zh: : 看吧！这又是一个例子——我不该不理解那些我本该理解的东西，因为我当时就是觉得你会这么想！

lines.en: : I might be inexperienced, but I’m not a fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 我可能没什么经验，但我不是他妈的白痴。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside9
: Well, I am and I apologize.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我才是，对不起。

lines.en: : It’s no secret that things are still a little weird with us and I just wanted to keep them as minimally weird as possible.
lines.zh: : 我们之间还有点别扭，这不是什么秘密，我只是想让这份别扭尽量少一点。

lines.en: : But unfortunately, I am going to be further complicating our relationship by now being the only daughter of a fractured household who must go on an epic journey to pick up all of its pieces.
lines.zh: : 但不幸的是，我现在要让我们这段关系变得更复杂了——我成了一个破碎家庭唯一的女儿，还必须踏上一段史诗般的旅程，去把所有的碎片捡起来。

lines.en: : I think you should maybe...leave the epic journey to the two of them. I doubt there’s much you can do to fix whatever problems may have led to this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也许该……把那段史诗般的旅程留给他们两个。不管是什么问题导致了这一切，我怀疑你也做不了什么。

lines.en: : I can’t fix {i}their{/i} relationship. I can’t fix {i}ours.{/i} What good even am I?
lines.zh: : 我修不好{i}他们{/i}的关系。我也修不好{i}我们{/i}的。我到底有什么用？

lines.en: : Do you actually think we need “fixing?”
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得我们之间需要“修”吗？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside10
: Do you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Nah. Just a little...tuning.
lines.zh: : 不。只是需要一点……调音。

lines.en: : Music analogy. Because we’re in the light music club. And we play music. You’re so cool.
lines.zh: : 音乐的比喻。因为我们在轻音部。因为我们玩音乐。你太酷了。

lines.en: : That better not be sarcasm.
lines.zh: : 那最好不是反话。

lines.en: : It’s not. I really do think you’re the coolest person, like...ever. And I’m sorry that I have once again burdened your greatness by accidentally exposing it to the downfall of my parents.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是真的觉得你是……有史以来最酷的人。也很抱歉，我又一次让我父母婚姻的崩塌意外拖累了你的伟大。

lines.en: : Oh, please. The downfall of your parents is the least of my worries when it comes to our relationship right now.
lines.zh: : 拜托。在我们现在的关系里，你父母的崩塌是我最不担心的事。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside11
: Wait, no. Forget I said that. That came out wrong.
lines.zh: : 等等，不。当我没说。那句话说得不对。

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean to make it sound like I’m worrying about something. I’m good.
lines.zh: : 我……不是故意说得好像我在担心什么。我很好。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Otoha. You can say it.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Otoha。你可以说。

lines.en: : Chances are I already know what it is anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我大概已经知道是什么了。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside12
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : If you already know what it is...how come you haven’t said anything about it?
lines.zh: : 如果你已经知道是什么了……为什么你自己一直没提？

lines.en: : Because you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 因为你错了。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside13
: This is technically a new conversation, so I’m going to start this time if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 严格来说这算是新的一段对话了，所以这次由我来开头，如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : Good. Because I have no idea how I’d do it without sounding like a complete bitch.
lines.zh: : 好。因为我完全不知道该怎么做，才能让自己听起来不像个彻头彻尾的泼妇。

lines.en: : Can I start by asking you for a favor?
lines.zh: : 我能先求你一件事吗？

lines.en: : A little unorthodox for the beginning to a serious talk, but sure.
lines.zh: : 在严肃谈话的开头提这个有点不合常理，不过说吧。

lines.en: : Have more faith in me.
lines.zh: : 多信任我一点。

lines.en: : There’s a big difference between keeping things from you because I’m an idiot who can’t figure out how you’ll react and literally just straight up cheating on you with a girl who doesn’t even like me.
lines.zh: : 因为我这个白痴猜不透你会有什么反应而瞒着你，和直接跟一个根本不喜欢我的女孩出轨，这两者之间差别可大了。

lines.en: : If she did like you, though...would that change anything?
lines.zh: : 不过如果她真的喜欢你……那会改变什么吗？

lines.en: : No. Right now, you’re the only girl I have my eyes on. And it’ll stay that way for as long as we’re together.
lines.zh: : 不会。现在，你是我唯一看得上眼的女孩。只要我们还在一起，这一点就不会变。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside14
: Why...Why’d you even let her into the club in the first place? She doesn’t even play music.
lines.zh: : 那……那你当初为什么还让她进社？她根本就不会乐器。

lines.en: : And you were so excited about it too. It’s almost like you {i}wanted{/i} her to join.
lines.zh: : 而且你当时还特别兴奋。简直像是你{i}希望{/i}她加入一样。

lines.en: : Because I did.
lines.zh: : 因为我确实是。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside15
: You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : I did want her to join. And I’m happy she’s a part of the club.
lines.zh: : 我确实希望她加入。我也很高兴她是我们社团的一员。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : She’s my friend, Otoha. A friend I’ve had for years. So what if I had a crush on her for most of those? She turned me down and I’m with you now.
lines.zh: : 她是我的朋友，Otoha。一个我认识了好几年的朋友。就算我在这几年里大部分时间都喜欢她，那又怎样？她拒绝了我，而我现在和你在一起。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just remove her from my life because of a thing that happened that never even went anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为一件从未真正发生过的事，就把她从我的生活里抹掉。

lines.en: : Rin, don’t take this the wrong way...but you’re not exactly well known for always thinking things through.
lines.zh: : Rin，别误会……可你并不是以“凡事想得周全”著称的人。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside16
: That’s kind of hard to {i}not{/i} take the wrong way when it makes it sound like you don’t trust me.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来像是不信任我，很难{i}不{/i}往坏处想啊。

lines.en: : Is that what you’re saying?
lines.zh: : 你是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what I’m saying. I just...I see the way you look at her and I can’t help but get worried.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己在说什么。我只是……我看见你看她的眼神，就忍不住担心。

lines.en: : Worried about what? That I’m just waiting for Chika to realize she was wrong and that she {i}does{/i} actually want to date me after all?
lines.zh: : 担心什么？担心我一直在等 Chika 意识到自己错了、其实她{i}真的{/i}想跟我交往？

lines.en: : See, this is why I didn’t want to talk about it. I know how it sounds. But even if we’re dating now, we still barely even know each other.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是我不想谈这件事的原因。我知道这听起来像什么。可就算我们现在在交往，我们也还几乎不了解彼此。

lines.en: : Why {i}wouldn’t{/i} you choose Chika over me if she actually {i}did{/i} change her mind about you?
lines.zh: : 如果她{i}真的{/i}改变了主意，你为什么{i}不会{/i}选她而不是我？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside17
: Ohhhhh...so that’s how it is.
lines.zh: : 噢——哦——原来是这样啊。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It’s less that you don’t trust me...and more that you’re just jealous.
lines.zh: : 与其说你不信任我……不如说你是嫉妒。

lines.en: : You think Chika has something you don’t...and that I’m only dating {i}you{/i} because things didn’t work out with her.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得 Chika 有我没有的东西……觉得我和你交往，只是因为我和她之间没成。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside18
: That’s not...no. There’s still a lot of context you’re ignoring. Or...missing. Or something.
lines.zh: : 那不是……不。还有很多背景你忽略了。或者……没看到。还是什么的。

lines.en: : Is there? Should I go back to being apprehensive? Or should I stay playful and fun so this conversation doesn’t take a turn for the worse?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我要不要重新变得忧心忡忡？还是该继续活泼有趣一点，好让这场对话不要往更糟的方向发展？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside19
: Huh?
: Hearing you’re jealous makes me happy. It means you don’t want to lose me. Which is good, because I was half convinced you were kind of indifferent about that at this point.
lines.zh: : 听到你嫉妒，我很开心。这说明你不想失去我。这很好，因为到现在为止我都有点半信半疑，觉得你对此其实挺无所谓的。

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。

lines.en: : So, what part are you {i}most{/i} jealous about? The fact that she has several years of a head start on you? Or the fact that she was the first girl I fell in love with?
lines.zh: : 那么，你{i}最{/i}嫉妒哪一点？是她比你早了好几年？还是她是我第一个爱上的女孩？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside20
: The {i}first{/i} girl you...fell in love with?
lines.zh: : 你{i}第一个{/i}……爱上的女孩？

lines.en: : Should I...not have said the L word? Because I know it’s weird to use it when nothing ever happened, but I still think my feelings at the time were strong enough for me to-
lines.zh: : 我是不是……不该说那个 L 开头的词？因为我知道在什么事都没发生过的情况下用它很奇怪，可我还是觉得我当时的感情强烈到足以让我——

lines.en: : No, no...I mean...
lines.zh: : 不，不是……我是说……

lines.en: : Wouldn’t saying {i}first{/i} imply that...I’m the second?
lines.zh: : 说“{i}第一个{/i}”，不就意味着……我是第二个吗？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside21
: ...Noooooo?
lines.zh: : ……没有吧？

lines.en: : Oh. Okay, yeah. Yeah, because now is still way too soon to start throwing big, serious words like that around.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧，是啊。是啊，因为现在就开始扔出这种又大又严肃的词，实在太早了。

lines.en: : Yuuuuuuup.
: And, like...we’re still too young to really even understand what “love” is anyway. Right?
lines.zh: : 而且，那个……我们还太年轻，根本不懂“爱”是什么。对吧？

lines.en: : Yuuuuuu-
scene otoharinoutside22
: Wait, no.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不对？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: ...Yeah?
: Yeah as in no. Like...I don’t agree with the thing you just said.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是“不对”的意思。就是……我不同意你刚才说的那句话。

lines.en: : What does it even mean when people say you can’t fall in love until you’re an adult? That makes literally zero sense.
lines.zh: : 人们说“不到成年就不能谈恋爱”，这到底是什么意思？这根本一点道理都没有。

lines.en: : Do our feelings not count until we reach a certain age? At what point have we lived long enough to fall in love?
lines.zh: : 难道我们的感情要活到某个年纪才算数吗？那我们要活多久，才够资格去爱？

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m just...you know...repeating what I’ve heard before...
lines.zh: : 呃……我只是……你知道的……在重复我以前听到过的话……

lines.en: : Did you...really feel that strongly about Chika, though?
lines.zh: : 不过……你对 Chika，真的有那么强烈的感情吗？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside23
: Uhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Will you get jealous again if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 如果我说有，你又会吃醋吗？

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. Because that would imply that I want you to love me and...it would be, like...totally way too early for that sort of thing. You know?
lines.zh: : 不会。因为那会暗示我想要你爱我，而……那种事，那个……现在说实在太早了。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: : I did feel that way about her.
lines.zh: : 我对她确实有过那种感情。

lines.en: : I would have done anything.
lines.zh: : 我愿意为她做任何事。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside24
: But getting my heart broken was a good thing...because it wound up leading me to you.
lines.zh: : 但心碎是件好事……因为它最终把我引向了你。

lines.en: : If I had never fallen in love with Chika, you and I never would have met. We wouldn’t be here right now trying to work out our problems.
lines.zh: : 如果我从来没有爱上 Chika，你我就永远不会相遇。我们也不会像现在这样坐在这里，努力解决我们的问题。

lines.en: : We wouldn’t be anything.
lines.zh: : 我们什么都不会是。

lines.en: : You don’t have to be jealous...or worry...or anything like that, Otoha. I’ll be just as loyal to you as you are to me. I promise.
lines.zh: : 你不必嫉妒……也不必担心……或者什么的，Otoha。我会像你对我一样忠诚地对你。我保证。

lines.en: : Besides, Chika’s already sleeping with Sensei anyway, so she’d never even hook up with me in the-
lines.zh: : 再说，Chika 反正已经在和 Sensei 上床了，所以她根本不可能会跟我搞——

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside25
: Mm!
: Chika is {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : Chika {i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside26
: Nothing! I...I have no idea why I...
lines.zh: : 没什么！我……我都不知道自己为什么……

lines.en: : That was a joke, right? Like...there’s no way those two are actually...
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑的，对吧？就是……他们两个不可能真的……

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside27
: I never said that, okay? Erase the last thirty seconds from your memory. I have no idea how I even...
lines.zh: : 我什么都没说，好吗？把过去三十秒从你的记忆里删掉。我都不知道自己是怎么……

lines.en: : Neither of them can know, okay? They’re both really important to me and I don’t want anything happening that might change the way they-
lines.zh: : 他们俩都不能知道，好吗？他们对我都很重要，我不希望发生任何事，改变他们对我的——

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, okay. Yeah, I won’t say anything. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，好吧。嗯，我不会说的。嗯。

lines.en: : Should, like...
lines.zh: : 那，那个……

lines.en: : Should we...{i}tell{/i} someone, though?
lines.zh: : 我们……该{i}告诉{/i}别人吗？

lines.en: : Tell them what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 告诉他们什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: : That...our teacher is sleeping with a-
lines.zh: : 就是……我们的老师在跟一个——

lines.en: : He’s not! {i}They’re{/i} not! Just...
lines.zh: : 他没有！{i}他们{/i}没有！就是……

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside28
: That...was just a fantasy of mine! Hahah! Silly, Rin! Always thinking about...people I know...having sex with each other...
lines.zh: : 那……只是我的一个幻想！哈哈哈！傻乎乎的 Rin！总是想着……我认识的人……互相做爱……

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside29
: Otoha, please...
lines.zh: : Otoha，拜托……

lines.en: scene black
scene otoharinoutside30
: So, yeah. That’s basically how you do it.
lines.zh: : 那么，是啊。基本上就是这么做的。

lines.en: : So...cool!
lines.zh: : 那么……酷！

lines.en: : Me? Nah. I’m embarrassing and worthless. I couldn’t even tie my tie this morning, so I had to leave it at home.
lines.zh: : 我？不。我又丢人又没用。我今天早上连领带都系不好，只好把它留在家里了。

lines.en: : But you? You’ve got a tie on right now. We are not the same.
lines.zh: : 可你现在打着领带呢。我们可不一样。

lines.en: : What do you think they’re talking about out there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她们在外面聊什么？

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside31
: Hm?
: Rin and Otoha. Rin looks really...panicky for some reason.
lines.zh: : Rin 和 Otoha。Rin 看起来……不知为什么特别慌。

lines.en: : Yeah, she does that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她经常这样。

lines.en: : I hope they’re not breaking up. I like those two together.
lines.zh: : 我希望她们不是在闹分手。我喜欢她们两个在一起。

lines.en: : If they are, this is probably the best possible time since the two of us could cry together about it. But yeah, I hope they’re not either. Even though I have only known Otoha for half an hour.
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，那大概是最佳时机，因为我们俩可以一起为这事哭一场。不过是啊，我也希望不是。虽然我认识 Otoha 才半个小时。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, I hope it turns out okay. Rin’s been through enough as-is and I really hate seeing her like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管是什么，我希望结果好一点。Rin 已经够倒霉了，我真的很讨厌看她那样。

lines.en: : Wow. No wonder she liked you for like a billion years. You’re sweet.
lines.zh: : 哇。难怪她喜欢了你大概十亿年。你真贴心。

lines.en: scene otoharinoutside32
: Hah...
: She’s just...
lines.zh: : 她只是……

lines.en: : She’s really unlucky.
lines.zh: : 她真的很不走运。

lines.en: scene black
scene noonsky
I wound up staying in my office with Noriko for at least another hour.
lines.zh: 结果我和 Noriko 又在办公室里待了至少一个小时。

lines.en: By the time we left, everyone else had already vacated the school.
lines.zh: 我们离开的时候，其他人早就离校了。

lines.en: Everyone except Rin and Otoha, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，除了 Rin 和 Otoha。

lines.en: But as I walked past them on the way out, neither of them made eye contact with me.
lines.zh: 但我出门路过她们身边时，她们俩都没有跟我对视。

lines.en: Thankfully, I had Noriko to distract me from their inattentiveness and keep me occupied the rest of the way home.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，一路上有 Noriko 分散我的注意力，让我不去在意她们的无视，也让我在回家的路上有事可做。

lines.en: Once we part ways, though...I can’t help but dredge it up again-
lines.zh: 可一旦我们分开……我还是忍不住又把它翻了出来——

lines.en: The image of two young girls, just inches apart on a bench-
lines.zh: 两个年轻女孩，坐在长椅上，只隔着几英寸——

lines.en: The mild red hues taking residence in their cheeks-
lines.zh: 她们脸颊上栖居着的淡淡红晕——

lines.en: scene black
And the slew of inappropriate things I think that could mean.
lines.zh: 以及那一连串涌上我心头的不合时宜的念头。
